tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250lok+t+ri'i brgyud 'debs ni/1$0000300 drang srong dri med dharma a shwa ka /bram ze legs grub pra bha hasti dang*// shān+tiṃ gar+bha pad+ma 'byung gnas la// gsol ba 'debs so sde brgyad zil non shog /khri srong yab sras nyang ral 'gro ba'i mgon// chos kyi dbang phyug pad+ma dbang chen dang*// mar ston sangs rgyas gnyan ston bkras seng la// gsol ba 'debs so sde brgyad zil non shog /chos nyid rang grol sangs rgyas lhun dbang dang*// kun dga' bkra shis rgyal sras chos kyi rje// chos 'phags bzang po shākya dpal bzang la// gsol ba 'debs so sde brgyad zil non shog /'jam dbyangs rgyal mtshan mkha' dbyings rdo rje dang// rin chen phun tshogs mnga' ris legs ldan zhabs// chos rgyal phun tshogs dbur smyon chos grags la// gsol ba 'debs so sde brgyad zil non shog /dkon mchog lhun grub chos rgyal gter bdag gling// rin chen rnam rgyal o rgyan bstan rdor dpal// phrin las rnam rgyal rtsa brgyud bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so sde brgyad zil non shog /rig gtad lung dang man ngag dmar khrid la// brten nas bskyed rim bsnyen srung zlog gsad kyi// phrin las kun 'grub ka dag mkha' dbyings su// lhun grub 'od lnga'i ye shes rdzogs par shog /
ces pa'ang 'gyur med rdo rjes so//
